keywords.title: Search Keywords / Signals
keywords.description: Keywords or bounty platform markers to search in open GitHub issues.

languages.title: Filter by Tech Stack / Language (optional)
languages.description: Optional language or keyword filters (e.g., typescript, python, rust, solidity, go). Leave empty for all.

minRewardUsd.title: Minimum Estimated Reward (USD)
minRewardUsd.description: Only keep issues with an extracted reward >= this USD amount (set 0 to include unpriced bounties).

maxComments.title: Maximum Comments (Anti-Saturation Filter)
maxComments.description: Skip crowded issues with more comments than this threshold.

onlyUnassigned.title: Only Unassigned Issues
onlyUnassigned.description: Exclude issues that already have an assignee.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ranked bounties to output.

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token (optional)
githubToken.description: Optional token for higher GitHub API rate limits (30 req/min vs 10 req/min unauthenticated).
